# Japan by Station

> English guides to Japan travel, organised around train stations: where to stay, what is within walking distance, local markets, nightlife, and how many minutes it takes to reach the airport, day trips and sights. Every time and price is checked against operators, airports and tourism bureaus, with the check date shown on each page.

## Tokyo
- [Kiyosumi-Shirakawa: Garden, MOT Museum or a Free Walk?](https://japanbystation.com/kiyosumi-shirakawa-what-to-pay-for): Sunny morning: Kiyosumi Gardens ¥150 from 9:00. Rainy afternoon: MOT Collection ¥500 (16 Dec 2026).
- [Yanaka Ginza: Which Way Should You Walk With Your Parents?](https://japanbystation.com/yanaka-ginza-which-direction): Nippori → down the Yuyake Dandan steps → Sendagi. Reverse it and the steps come last, uphill.
- [Monzen-nakacho: Is Market Day the Best Day to Visit?](https://japanbystation.com/monzen-nakacho-market-day): Quiet morning: a Tuesday–Friday that isn't the 1st, 15th or 28th. Antiques: Sundays 6, 13 and 27 Dec 2026.
- [Kagurazaka Lunch: Main Street or Back Lanes?](https://japanbystation.com/kagurazaka-lunch-main-street-or-lanes): Main street from ¥990 (weekdays), alley yuba lunch to 14:00 L.O., or walk the lanes and eat after 2 p.m.
- [Asakusa: Should You Book Across the River in Azumabashi or Honjo?](https://japanbystation.com/asakusa-across-the-river): On our dates the west bank was ¥505 cheaper than the bridge hotel. Farther out saves ¥7,585, with a shared bathroom.
- [Senso-ji Before Breakfast or After Dinner?](https://japanbystation.com/sensoji-morning-or-evening): Inside the main hall: go early. Lit-up photos: go after dinner. Nakamise shops: midday.
- [Two Hours Before Dinner in Shinjuku: Garden, Skyline or Side Streets?](https://japanbystation.com/shinjuku-two-hours-before-dinner): Gyoen's last entry is 16:00 in winter. After that, the free observatory or Shinjuku-sanchome.
- [Would You Stay Outside Shibuya for a Quieter Morning?](https://japanbystation.com/shibuya-quiet-base-yoyogi): Neither is one stop from Shibuya. Same-night prices, the trip home after dinner and who the quieter base really suits.
- [Shibuya Crossing: Is It Worth Paying to See It From Above?](https://japanbystation.com/shibuya-crossing-view): Free from Hachiko Square, a drink for the Starbucks window, ¥1,800 for the MAG8 rooftop or ¥2,700+ for Shibuya Sky. Which view fits you.
- ["Shinjuku" on the Booking: Which Station Will You Actually Use?](https://japanbystation.com/shinjuku-which-station): JR Shinjuku, Shinjuku-sanchome or Higashi-shinjuku? Same-night prices and the trips each one makes easy.

## Osaka
- [Itami Sky Park: Can You Watch Planes Without a Car?](https://japanbystation.com/itami-sky-park-without-a-car): Hankyu to Itami + city bus 25 = ¥490 each way. Best day: go out via the airport deck, back via the bus.
- [Is NIFREL Worth a Two-Hour Trip?](https://japanbystation.com/nifrel-two-hours): Two hours inside: plenty. Two hours door to door: about 50 min inside from Umeda, under 30 from Namba.
- [Three Nights on ¥30,000: Namba or Tennoji Before a Kansai Airport Flight?](https://japanbystation.com/namba-or-tennoji-30000-yen): Room + airport trains + three evenings out: Namba ¥16,681, Tennoji ¥16,898 on our dates. Both leave over ¥13,000 of the budget.
- [Sakai: Can You Watch a Knife Being Made Without Booking?](https://japanbystation.com/sakai-watch-knife-making): Free sharpening demo every Friday 13:30–15:00, no booking. Forges want 10–15 days' notice.
- [Nakazakicho vs Umeda: Would You Walk for ¥3,000 Less a Night?](https://japanbystation.com/nakazakicho-vs-umeda-hotel): About ¥9,500 saved over three nights for a 12-minute walk. A taxi costs from ¥600.
- [Minoh Falls in Autumn: Leave Osaka at 1, Back Before Dark?](https://japanbystation.com/minoh-falls-autumn-afternoon): Umeda at 13:00 still works on a weekday: falls by 14:15, back before the 16:48 sunset. The shorter walk, and when to leave earlier.
- [Cup Noodles Museum Ikeda: Design a Cup, Make Noodles, or Just Explore?](https://japanbystation.com/cup-noodles-museum-ikeda): ¥500 cup on the day, a 70-minute noodle workshop you must book, or the free museum. Which one fits your visit.
- [Can ¥5,000 Buy a Private Room Near Namba?](https://japanbystation.com/namba-5000-yen-private-room): Wednesday: a private room from ¥2,998. Saturday: ¥5,000 buys a capsule. Real prices for two sampled nights.
- [Four Friends in Osaka: One Apartment or Two Hotel Rooms?](https://japanbystation.com/osaka-four-friends): Apartment, apartment hotel or two twins? What changes for four people, and how to check a rental is legal.
- [Where to Stay in Osaka If You're Out Late](https://japanbystation.com/osaka-night-owls): The subway stops around midnight. Stay where you can walk home: Namba, Ura-Namba or Tenma.
- [Where to Stay in Osaka to Live Like a Local](https://japanbystation.com/osaka-live-like-a-local): Tenma and Tsuruhashi: shopping streets, izakaya alleys and quiet mornings, still a few stops from Namba and Umeda.
- [Local Markets in Osaka Beyond Kuromon](https://japanbystation.com/osaka-local-markets): Kizu, Tsuruhashi and Japan's longest shopping street: where Osaka shops for dinner, with hours and closing days.
- [Where to stay in Osaka: Namba, Umeda or Tennoji?](https://japanbystation.com/osaka-where-to-stay): Three areas on one red subway line. What's outside each door, and who each one suits.
- [Things to do around Namba, all within a 15-minute walk](https://japanbystation.com/namba): The canal, the food streets and the shopping arcades, with walking times from Exit 14.
- [Kansai Airport to Osaka: which train for your hotel](https://japanbystation.com/kansai-airport-to-osaka): Nankai or JR? Pick the line that stops at your hotel and skip the transfer.
